The '''assault blaster rifle''' was a [[Mandalorian assault rifle]] modified by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. A precision weapon used by military units, it was one of the most precise weapons of its time.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

[[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] used this type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], as did [[Incavi Larado]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].
